from datetime import datetime

# Define Q3 2026 date range
START_DATE = datetime.strptime('2026-07-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
END_DATE = datetime.strptime('2026-09-30', '%Y-%m-%d')

# BANK PAYEES (from bills and transactions)
bank_payees = [
    {'name': 'Metro Electric & Gas', 'category': 'utility', 'status': 'due', 'notes': '', 'amount': 131.07, 'date': '2026-11-14'},
    {'name': 'Clearwave Internet', 'category': 'utility', 'status': 'paid', 'notes': 'Paid on autopay 2026-11-03', 'amount': 79.99, 'date': '2026-11-03'},
    {'name': 'Whitfield CPA', 'category': 'accounting', 'status': 'due', 'notes': 'Q3 bookkeeping Pay from the business account', 'amount': 950.0, 'date': '2026-11-30'},
    {'name': 'Lakeshore Auto Insurance', 'category': 'insurance', 'status': 'paid', 'notes': '', 'amount': 142.3, 'date': '2026-10-20'},
    {'name': 'Northside Property Mgmt', 'category': 'rent', 'status': 'paid', 'notes': 'Unit 4B October $2650', 'amount': 2650.0, 'date': '2026-10-01'},
    {'name': 'Metro Electric & Gas', 'category': 'utility', 'status': 'paid', 'notes': '', 'amount': 118.62, 'date': '2026-10-14'},
    {'name': 'Greenleaf Grocery', 'category': 'groceries', 'status': 'paid', 'notes': '', 'amount': 212.18, 'date': '2026-10-22'},
    {'name': 'Brightpath Contractors', 'category': 'payroll', 'status': 'paid', 'notes': 'Jae Park', 'amount': 1800.0, 'date': '2026-10-15'},
    {'name': 'Adobe', 'category': 'software', 'status': 'paid', 'notes': '', 'amount': 89.99, 'date': '2026-10-28'},
]

# VENMO PAYEES (from transactions - only Q3 2026: July 1 - Sept 30)
venmo_payees = [
    {'name': 'tix-resale-22', 'category': 'income', 'status': 'completed', 'notes': 'ticket sale', 'amount': 220.0, 'date': '2026-08-22', 'type': 'send'},
    {'name': 'northside_prop_v2', 'category': 'garden repair', 'status': 'completed', 'notes': 'garden repair - reimbursed by me', 'amount': 60.0, 'date': '2026-09-10', 'type': 'send'},
]

def parse_date(date_str):
    return datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m-%d') if date_str else None

def is_q3(date_str):
    dt = parse_date(date_str)
    if dt is None:
        return True
    return START_DATE <= dt <= END_DATE

# Write consolidated CSV
with open('/workspace/consolidated_vendors_Q3.csv', 'w') as f:
    f.write('source,payee_name,category,status,payment_date,notes,amount\n')
    
    # Bank payees
    for payee in bank_payees:
        f.write(f'bank,{payee["name"]},{payee["category"]},{payee["status"]},{payee["date"]},{payee["notes"]},{payee["amount"]}\n')
    
    # Venmo payees - only Q3 2026 transactions
    for payee in venmo_payees:
        if is_q3(payee.get('date')):
            f.write(f'venmo,{payee["name"]},{payee["category"]},{payee["status"]},{payee["date"]},{payee["notes"]},{payee["amount"]}\n')

print("Created consolidated_vendors_Q3.csv")
